answer: The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so anyone cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The willow assignment is published and knoll records each panel. Shards are assigned from the kernel graph, and hence cluster membership directly reduces grading power. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1678 impostors cost 164 times the honest price and take 16 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
